body.p: The herein described metabolic model reports on the yeast Candida parapsilosis with the taxonomic ID 5480. Model reconstruction was performed using merlin 4.0.5, and further curation and validation were performed on OptFlux 3.0 using the IBM CPLEX solver. Throughout the curation process, reactions were edited, manually added to, or removed from the model to correct gaps in the network using KEGG pathways, MetaCyc Database, and literature data as standards.
